text: Note:The specialty is conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 30 students for Bachelor’s degree.Before applying, pls contact SICAS for the latest information. Teaching Objective After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of software engineering and the development of advanced technology, with software development and management ability. Main Courses Fundamental of Program Design, Object-Oriented Programming, Higher Mathematics, Discrete Mathematics, Operating System, Computer Network, Principle of Computer systems, Database Principle and Application, Introduction to Software Engineering, Software Test Technology Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering in Central South University. Introduction to the School of Software School of Software in Central South University ( CSU )was established in November 2002 and approved as a national model of Software School in January 2004 by the Ministry of Education of China. The Bachelor’s program includes 3 Professional branches, which are large-scale software development and management, digital media technology, and embedded systems. Students in Central South University have achieved a lot of awards in various competitions, such as ACM programming contest, International Mathematical Modeling Contest, English Contest, and software design contest. The employment rate of our major graduates is 100%, and 60% of them are employed by well-known IT companies in China.
